name: Fight_HandleRewardGrantOrSkipByPostBattleFlags

name: Fight_TryAssignBotPartByRoll
comment: GH-RW confirmado: count < roll(0..99) ou Pick==0 -> Fight_AssignRandomBotPartSlot(3)

name: Fight_CountAvailableBotParts
comment: GH-RW confirmado: +10 por peca kind 1..3 com atual==0 em inimigos 3..5 ativos (bloco+0xBA)

name: Fight_PickRandomAvailableBotPart
comment: GH-RW confirmado: slot=3+tab 0x083AD070[rand&F]; kind=rand&3; 1a peca que o jogador nao tem; grava 0x03001968/69/87

name: Fight_AssignRandomBotPartSlot
comment: GH-RW confirmado: sorteio cego de slot/kind (sem checar posse); grava 0x03001968/69/87

name: Battle_SumPartBytesToCtx16C
comment: GH-RW confirmado: fi+0x16C += soma de bytes +0x52/+0x6A/+0x82/+0x9A de inimigos 3..5 ativos (XP do fim da luta)

name: Fight_AwardPartExperience
comment: GH-RW confirmado: para bots 0..2 ativos, XP (fi+0x16C) vai para a MEDALHA (bloco+1 = id de gMedals) na tabela 0x03000BE0 (rec+2 XP, rec+5 nivel); medaforca nivel 10/30/60

name: Fight_SelectTemplateForCurrentEncounter
comment: GH-RW confirmado: se E+0xC2D==0 sorteia (40/30/20/10); se 1 usa E+0xC2A direto (historia)

name: Fight_InitializeBotFromTemplate
comment: GH-RW confirmado: cabeca 14 B -> bloco+0x0A (literal 0x030A), medalha +1/+4/+6/+7, nivel +5, especialidade +0x20.. = T[(bot+4)*8+k]*(bot+5>>1); bloco = 0x03000590+(3+k)*0x100

name: Fight_SceneStep48_CheckTimeUpOrLevelUp
comment: GH-RW confirmado: T+0x57==0 -> Fight_EvaluateTeamWinState + snd 0x11; senao 0x4F ou 0x60

name: Fight_EvaluateTeamWinState
comment: GH-RW confirmado: grava fi+0x9C = 1 ou 2 por contagem de bots com status 2, slots vazios e bytes +0x29/+0x31 (empate: randbyte); derrota = 2 (provavel)

name: GameState_StartFlowByCommand
comment: GH-RW confirmado: caso 0x20 grava E+0xC2D=1, 0x0300178C=0, 0x03002B8C=6, 0x0300137C=0; caso 0x21 grava E+0xC2D=0

name: EventOpcode33_StartBattle_Continuation

name: DAT_08010C74_E_base

name: won_bodypart_type

name: fight_post_battle_xp

name: won_bodypart_slot
